description: Resolve a natural-language food order (one or more items) to concrete menu items and return a summary plus a confirmation token. Does NOT place the order. Call place_order with the returned token to actually place it. Delivery is as soon as possible by default; pass 'date' to ask for a later time instead. Each call covers one delivery, so an order for more than one day means one call per day. The restaurant may still refuse a time it is not open for.

bringTerminal.description: Whether the courier should bring a card terminal so the order can be paid by card on delivery. Pass true when the user wants to pay by card, false for cash; omit when they do not say. Ignored (with a note) by vendors that cannot take card on delivery.

clientId.description: clientId of the restaurant, from a list_vendors result. Omit only when the server is configured for a single restaurant.

cutlery.description: Whether to ask the restaurant to include disposable cutlery. Only pass this when the user says either way; omit to leave it to the restaurant's default. Ignored (with a note) by vendors that do not offer it.

date.description: Delivery date-time as an ISO-8601 UTC instant, e.g. '2026-07-25T12:00:00Z'. Must be in the future. Defaults to 5 minutes from now (as soon as possible) — only pass this when the user asks for a specific time.

items.description: The item(s) to order — one or more lines, each with an item name, an optional quantity (default 1), an optional size, and optional extra ingredients by name.

extras.description: Extra ingredients to add to this item, by name, e.g. ['Šunka']. Each must be one of the extras that item offers (its own composition ingredients are not addable); repeat a name to add it twice.

quantity.description: Quantity for this item, at least 1. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

size.description: Requested size by name, e.g. '33cm' or 'Large'. Selects that size variant of the item; omit for the standard size. A size the item is not available in is rejected with the list of sizes it does offer.

vendorId.description: vendorId of the restaurant, from a list_vendors result. Omit only when the server is configured for a single restaurant.

name: prepare_order
title: Prepare an order
